item.title: BPL Debt, Tax Enforcement, Back-to-School Savings
item.ns0:title: BPL Debt, Tax Enforcement, Back-to-School Savings
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the financial spotlight intensifies on Bahamas Power and Light as government funding climbs alongside a deepening employee overtime controversy. We examine a major escalation in tax collections as the government steps up enforcement on unpaid revenues, and bring you critical back-to-school warnings from police ahead of the new academic year. Plus, the Attorney General addresses the legal path forward in a high-profile missing person's investigation, and we celebrate the highly-anticipated return of a beloved restaurant brand to Grand Bahama after twenty-five years. Stay tuned for these headlines, a look at cutting-edge robotics arriving in the capital, and your complete sports and weather updates.
